From 30d5297862410418bb8f8b4c0a87fa55c3063dd7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Thomas=20Wei=C3=9Fschuh?= <linux@weissschuh.net>
Date: Sun, 4 Feb 2024 18:30:43 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] power: supply: mm8013: select REGMAP_I2C
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The driver uses regmap APIs so it should make sure they are available.

Fixes: c75f4bf6800b ("power: supply: Introduce MM8013 fuel gauge driver")
Cc:  <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Weißschuh <linux@weissschuh.net>
Reviewed-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240204-mm8013-regmap-v1-1-7cc6b619b7d3@weissschuh.net
Signed-off-by: Sebastian Reichel <sebastian.reichel@collabora.com>

diff --git a/drivers/power/supply/Kconfig b/drivers/power/supply/Kconfig
index f21cb05815ec..3e31375491d5 100644
--- a/drivers/power/supply/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/power/supply/Kconfig
@@ -978,6 +978,7 @@ config CHARGER_QCOM_SMB2
 config FUEL_GAUGE_MM8013
 	tristate "Mitsumi MM8013 fuel gauge driver"
 	depends on I2C
+	select REGMAP_I2C
 	help
 	  Say Y here to enable the Mitsumi MM8013 fuel gauge driver.
 	  It enables the monitoring of many battery parameters, including
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/power/supply/Kconfig`**
   - Added a line to the configuration for the Mitsumi MM8013 fuel gauge driver (`FUEL_GAUGE_MM8013`):
     - `select REGMAP_I2C`
   - This modification ensures that the driver can utilize the regmap APIs by making the REGMAP_I2C dependency explicit.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in the `Kconfig` file establishes a dependency for the MM8013 fuel gauge driver on the REGMAP_I2C configuration. This relationship is crucial because the driver relies on regmap APIs for its functionality, and by selecting REGMAP_I2C, it guarantees that these APIs are available when the driver is compiled. This modification addresses a potential issue where the driver might not function correctly if the necessary regmap support is not included.

power: supply: mm8013: select REGMAP_I2C
MIME-Version: 1.0

The driver uses regmap APIs so it should make sure they are available.

Fixes: c75f4bf6800b ("power: supply: Introduce MM8013 fuel gauge driver")
Cc:  <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Weißschuh <linux@weissschuh.net>
Reviewed-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240204-mm8013-regmap-v1-1-7cc6b619b7d3@weissschuh.net
Signed-off-by: Sebastian Reichel <sebastian.reichel@collabora.com>

Here is the root cause:
The Mitsumi MM8013 fuel gauge driver was not explicitly selecting the REGMAP_I2C configuration, which is necessary for the driver to access the regmap APIs it relies on. Without this selection, the driver may fail to compile or function correctly if the regmap support is not included in the build, leading to potential runtime errors or incorrect behavior.

Here is the patch:
 	tristate "Mitsumi MM8013 fuel gauge driver"
 	depends on I2C
+	select REGMAP_I2C
 	help
 	  Say Y here to enable the Mitsumi MM8013 fuel gauge driver.
